text:
rachel.design: Heads-up — small copy pass for the 'Route rate limit exceeded' banner in the Routes page. Current text is 'Rate limit reached. Reduce requests.' which feels abrupt and unhelpful. Looking for options that give clear next steps for users. ben.pm: totally. we should tell them where to go (rate limit docs) and whether retrying later will work. Also include the route name or id to make support easier. kevin.eng: we can detect if the user is hitting per-route or account limit. If per-route, include suggested actions: increase concurrency, add a dedicated pool, or contact support. Avoid making the banner too tall though. mira.a11y: accessibility reminder: banners are announced via aria-live; keep the message concise but self-contained. If we include a link, its text must make sense out of context. Also avoid long sentences; SR users get the whole string read. rachel.design: Microcopy candidates (compact): - A: 'Route "chat-prod" hit its rate limit. Pause or retry later. Learn how to increase limits.' - B: 'Youve reached the rate limit for this route. To fix: reduce request rate, use a dedicated pool, or see docs.' - C (shortest): 'Rate limit hit on route chat-prod. View options.' Which balances clarity vs brevity? ben.pm: I like A but change 'Pause' to 'Retry later' and make the link text 'Increase limits' instead of 'Learn how to increase limits'. Short links. kevin.eng: prefer B for actionability but it's wordy. Maybe A with action bullets in the banner expanded state. For small screens, keep C with tooltip expanding. mira.a11y: if you go with A, make sure the link is 'Increase limits for this route' or use aria-describedby to tie the banner to a hidden explainer. Example for SR-friendly variant:

This rate limit applies to requests per minute for route chat-prod. Consider a dedicated pool or contact support to raise limits.

Increase limits for this route ui-bot: rollout note: banner component 1.14.2 includes collapsed/expanded states and supports aria-describedby. rachel.design: updated proposal: Visual banner copy: 'Route chat-prod hit its rate limit.' Primary action: 'View options' (opens actionable sheet). Secondary link: 'Increase limits' (goes to docs) with aria-describedby referencing hidden paragraph explaining why and next steps. Banner will include the route id for context. ben.pm: add analytics on which action they click and whether they follow docs to upgrade. Also prefer 'Retry later' guidance somewhere in the expanded sheet. kevin.eng: implementational notes: keep banner one line on small widths and show chevron to open expansion. aria-expanded on the chevron button is important. For SRs, when opened, the expanded content should receive focus and be announced. mira.a11y: checklist: concise aria-live message, meaningful link text or aria-describedby, focus management when expanding, aria-expanded on toggle, and test with NVDA/VoiceOver. rachel.design: thanks! I'll update the copy tokens and the Figma banner component with these changes and post a mock. Tagging @ben.pm for final product sign-off. :sparkles:
